title: Workable Jobs Scraper - Every Opening From Any Workable Board

boards.title: Workable boards
boards.description: Company domains, names, or careers URLs - paste your list as-is. acme.com, www.acme.com and the full board URL all work. The board token is the company slug in apply.workable.com/<company>.

titleKeywords.title: Title keywords
titleKeywords.description: Keep only jobs whose title contains any of these.

excludeKeywords.title: Exclude keywords
excludeKeywords.description: Drop jobs whose title or department matches any of these.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Keep only jobs whose location matches any of these.

departments.title: Departments or teams
departments.description: Keep only jobs in a matching department or team.

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within days
postedWithinDays.description: Only jobs posted in the last N days. 0 means no limit. Set 1 for a daily new-jobs feed.

includeDescription.title: Include full description
includeDescription.description: Add the full job description text. Makes results much larger.

onlyNewSinceLastRun.title: Only what changed since the last run
onlyNewSinceLastRun.description: Return only jobs that opened since your last run (isNew) and jobs that have since closed (isClosed). The first run records a baseline and returns everything. Built for a daily schedule: a run with no changes returns nothing and costs only the start fee. Changing the boards or filters starts a fresh baseline.

maxJobsPerBoard.title: Max jobs per board
maxJobsPerBoard.description: Cap results per board. 0 means no limit. Starts at 10 so a first trial run stays cheap - clear it to get everything.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: How many boards to fetch in parallel.
